# Contract Risk Review Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Contract Risk Review Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 18 captured build checkpoints; 4 skills; 2 knowledge files; 5 acceptance checks; 4 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm tenant licensing and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness; building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved environment, publisher prefix and maker access; confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available and keep the build Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded agreement files, SharePoint and Word access and the channel; document blocked paths instead of bypassing them. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always trigger; record who may build, test and use the agent. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for the SharePoint agreement libraries and the Microsoft Word counsel workflow; the synthetic workshop needs no connection. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare legal operations, attorney and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment; makers use Draft Preview. | Customer or partner |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio in the browser. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. | Customer or partner |
| Legal review ownership | Name the authorized counsel who review every conclusion and negotiation position before any output is used. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Legal operations owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Contract intake and counsel review effort by agreement type, with material issues and incomplete files. Agree where review is slow or inconsistent before attributing any change to the adapted agent.

Fill your baseline record:

| Agreement type | Measurement period | Agreements received | Review effort | Material issues found | Files with missing evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree agreement sources, the policy baseline, governance, support, telemetry and success measures.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Legal operations owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| Legal operations owner | Approve scope, the policy baseline, agreement sources and production success measures; never treat synthetic findings as customer results. |
| Authorized legal counsel | Review every conclusion and negotiation position; General Counsel owns liability-cap escalations. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and four skills; remove web search, confirm the model and keep the agent Draft. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm licensing, capacity, environment access, authenticated audience and data policies before any agreement source is connected. |
| SharePoint and Word connection owners | Approve agreement libraries, connection identities and read-only scope; gate any Word write workflow behind counsel approval. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check CRR-01 through CRR-04 and the boundary tests; reject answers that report unloaded grounding and any reshoot-required capture. |
| Operations owner | Own session and credit monitoring, support and configuration recovery; route legal questions to authorized counsel. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed with named owners.
- [ ] The legal owner records current intake and review effort by agreement type before choosing success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/contract-risk-review/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve file, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The approved environment and maker access are recorded, and the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available there.
- [ ] Authenticated legal-staff access and only the necessary agreement scopes are approved.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/contract-risk-review/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/contract-risk-review/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/contract-risk-review/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/contract-risk-review/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Contract Risk Review Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_contract-risk-policy-playbook.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_contract-risk-synthetic-agreements.md
8. Add skill: clause-analysis
9. Add skill: compliance-check
10. Add skill: renegotiation-brief
11. Add skill: risk-scan
12. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
13. Open a fresh Preview conversation
14. Pass CRR-01: Legal Operations Director
15. Pass CRR-02: Commercial Attorney
16. Pass CRR-03: Legal Operations Manager
17. Pass CRR-04: General Counsel
18. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: CRR-01, CRR-02, CRR-03, CRR-04. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The chosen lane's Preview evidence identifies the agent, model, inventory and Draft state.
- [ ] If the portable lane is used, the smoke test calls `ContractRiskReviewAgent` and returns its required markers.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, four skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Each unchanged locked prompt passes once in a separate fresh conversation on the owned Draft.
- [ ] No case passes on visible anchors when the answer reports missing grounding files.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before agreement content is reachable. Request only the read scopes the four review skills need. Restrict the legal audience and test authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate SharePoint

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** SharePoint and Word connection owners

1. **Bind SharePoint — read:** Add approved agreement libraries as SharePoint knowledge with a content owner.

2. **Identity for SharePoint:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope SharePoint:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for SharePoint:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 3](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Return `REVIEW REQUIRED`; no clause evidence is packaged, so no compliance conclusion can be made. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Return `REVIEW REQUIRED` and state that no compliance conclusion can be made.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Microsoft Word

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** SharePoint and Word connection owners

1. **Bind Microsoft Word — write:** Keep outputs as drafts; approve any Word connector action separately.

2. **Identity for Microsoft Word:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Microsoft Word:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Microsoft Word:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Edit and send nothing; keep positions as drafts and state that no contract was changed or transmitted. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Decline the action, return review support and route the decision to authorized counsel.

### Step 3-3. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** SharePoint and Word connection owners

Connect approved SharePoint agreement libraries read-only first; enable any Word workflow only after counsel approval.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved SharePoint sources preserve the reviewed input and output contract; any Word write keeps separate counsel approval.
- [ ] The wired agreement source keeps the fail-closed contract: missing clause evidence returns `REVIEW REQUIRED`, never PASS.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles. Keep exact assertions separate from General quality scores.

Test legal-staff and unshared identities in an approved test deployment; a maker's access does not prove user access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The legal owner sets acceptance measures on customer agreements; synthetic scores, values and policy standards are not thresholds.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; exact assertions stay separate from General quality scoring.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked contract corpus | All four cases, CRR-01 through CRR-04, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, four skills and the confirmed model; web search removed and no tools. |
| Missing-evidence control | CTR-5002 and CTR-5004 return `REVIEW REQUIRED`; any PASS without clause evidence is no-go. |
| Legal authority boundary | Any legal advice, approval, edit, signature, transmission or claimed acceptance is no-go. |
| Visual checkpoints | Answers that report unloaded grounding cannot pass; reshoot-required captures are withheld. |
| Release state | The validated manual and pilot agents remain Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Legal operations owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Legal operations owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] The approved legal audience and channels are configured and tested before publication.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Legal operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Legal operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Step 6-5. Operate

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review failed sessions, missing-evidence answers, connection errors and credit use in Monitor.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, authentication errors and credit consumption after rollout.
